LanguageData.RatkinQL_PilgrimTree_Report: A weary ratkin pilgrim asked for shelter and a meal.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Pilgrim_Greeting: A dust-coated ratkin leans on a walking stick. "I am on my way to the holy shrine. Might I beg a meal and a corner to rest in, here at {Interviewer_labelShort}?"
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Pilgrim_OptMeal: Offer a meal and a place to rest (3 hardtack).
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Pilgrim_OptStory: Ask what shrine he is bound for.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Pilgrim_OptBlessing: Ask him to bless the settlement.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Pilgrim_OptBack: Return to the matter at hand.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Pilgrim_Story1: "I am walking to the peak temple to fulfil a vow from the famine years. I promised the earth-mother I would come barefoot to her altar."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Pilgrim_Story2: "My brother died of the creeping cough last spring. I carry his ashes to the shrine of the ancestors, so his spirit may find the warm burrow."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Pilgrim_Story3: "I swore to the old stones that if my child survived the fever, I would make this journey once every five years. This is my third time."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Pilgrim_Farewell: He presses his palms together, bows, and shuffles out into the dusk. "The earth will remember your kindness."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Pilgrim_MsgMeal: He eats slowly, then lays a hand on your stove. "May this hearth never run short of grain or warmth."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Pilgrim_MsgBlessing: He closes his eyes and murmurs a low chant, then opens them and smiles. "The deep earth watches over this place now."
